title: 超越路由权重：通过贡献对比实现MoE奖励模型的忠实响应级解释
summary: 提出CoCo方法，通过选择-拒绝响应对的贡献对比来忠实解释MoE奖励模型中专家角色，同时捕捉路由和偏好行为。自动和人工评估显示，CoCo比基于路由、评分和稀疏自编码器的方法更连贯、忠实和专门化，同时保持竞争性的奖励建模精度。
summary_en: Propose CoCo, a contribution-contrast method for faithful response-level interpretation of MoE reward models, capturing both routing and preference behavior. Evaluations show CoCo yields more coherent, faithful, and specialized interpretations than alternatives while maintaining competitive accuracy.
